0022600035.text: The Orlando Magic (4-7, 10th in the East, on a two-game win streak) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-11, 15th in the East, on an eight-game losing streak) in the Magic's 12th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Orlando is 0-4 at home, while Milwaukee is 0-5 on the road, and Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jamal Cain, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero and Tristan da Silva, while Milwaukee is without Myles Turner (rest) and Ryan Rollins (day-to-day with a head issue, a game-time decision). The Magic won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 130-91 win in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026, and no games between the teams have been played yet this season.
